1 – 3 years

Software implementation or consultation experience

N/A

jobs.title: Implementation Coordinator
jobs.description:
**We are Local Infusion.**
--------------------------

Local Infusion is the fastest growing infusion provider in the United States, with a mission to transform the specialty infusion industry, because patients deserve better. By providing both exceptional, patient-centered care and the proprietary, AI-driven technology powering it, Local Infusion accelerates access, simplifies workflows, and improves outcomes for everyone in the infusion journey — from patients and clinicians to health plans, health systems, employers, and pharma.  
  
Clinicians can spend less time on paperwork and more time with patients, bringing comfort, connection, and community back to healthcare. With Local Infusion, every patient and every care team is fully supported, every step of the way. Through a blend of patient-centered design and a people-first team culture, Local Infusion puts the “local feel” of community, comfort, and connection back into the patient and provider experience. Our time to treat is 4x faster than the industry average, and our patient Net Promoter Score (NPS) is 99%.

**The Role**
------------

The **Implementation Coordinator** will contribute to the company’s growth and quality by launching new centers and ensuring a smooth opening process. This person will work closely with the Director of Implementation to open new centers, enabling our patients to receive best in class care. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously across markets.

**Location**
------------

* **Remote** + Travel (2-3 days / 3 weeks of the month)
* **EST or CST** timezone preferred; must live in close proximity to a major International airport

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Deliver new center openings in an efficient, scalable, and timely manner, from planning through project completion while meeting budgetary requirements
* Maintain the progress of each project timeline, milestone, dependencies and blockers
* Ensure all departments are aligned on deliverables, deadlines and readiness of requirement
* Partner with local market owners to launch a new center while aligning facility readiness, inventory/equipment set up and patient value around a shared goal and timeline

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communication, Project Coordination, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
* 2-5 years of project management preferred
* Strong project coordination and communication skills
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with vendors, contractors etc.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and budgets
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Outlook, Excel, Adobe, and similar tools
* Ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization
* Must be able to life 25+lbs
* Must be able to be mobile and standing for 5-6 hours when completing a center set up

**The Local Infusion Way**
--------------------------

Local Infusion is a respectful upbeat team united by our mission of shaping the way specialty infusion care is delivered. We are highly ambitious but understand that in order to do a great job, we have to take care of ourselves; we expect that you will have time and energy devoted to your families, friends and hobbies.

As part of our team, full-time employees get:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance through our employer plan
* Short and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) — as an early-stage startup, and we match!
* 15 Days PTO — and we want you to take it!
* Competitive paid parental leave and flexible return to work policy.
* We invest in your career. Our company is growing quickly, and we'll give you the opportunity to do the same. You'll have access to a number of professional development opportunities so that you can keep up with the company's evolving needs and grow your career along the way.

We don’t discriminate—Local Infusion is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We fundamentally believe that a more diverse and inclusive team leads to a stronger company more able to achieve our vision.

*All Intake Coordinator's must provide documentation of a negative TB test (within the last two years), and a current BLS certification. Hepatitis B and influenza vaccination records are also requested as part of the onboarding process.*

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
The **Implementation Manager** is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the installation, integration, testing, deployment, operational startup, and expansion of Customer Experience Quality Assurance (CQA) resources across all program phases. This role ensures seamless transition from design and testing into production operations by integrating technology, facilities, staffing, training, security, and operational readiness activities. The Implementation Manager manages dependencies, risk, resource scaling, and readiness gates to deliver successful operational launches and ongoing expansion initiatives.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of complex contact center, customer experience, and IT service delivery environments.
* Coordinate installation, integration, testing, deployment, and operational startup activities across multiple workstreams.
* Develop and manage integrated implementation schedules covering technology, facilities, workforce, training, security, and operational readiness.
* Establish and manage implementation milestones, dependencies, stage gates, and go-live readiness reviews.
* Coordinate system, user acceptance, operational, and production readiness testing activities.
* Manage transitions from development and testing environments into production operations.
* Oversee workforce ramp-up, capacity expansion, and scale-down activities to align with program requirements.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate implementation risks and issues that could impact schedule, budget, or operational performance.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including program management, engineering, operations, training, security, and infrastructure stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with organizational, contractual, security, and operational requirements throughout implementation activities.
* Develop implementation plans, deployment strategies, contingency plans, and rollback procedures.
* Monitor implementation performance metrics and drive continuous improvement throughout deployment cycles.
* Support executive leadership with implementation status reporting, readiness assessments, and decision support.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10-15 years of experience implementing complex contact center, customer experience, or enterprise IT environments.
* At least 7 years of experience leading large-scale implementations, transitions, operational startups, or deployment programs.
* Demonstrated experience moving enterprise-scale systems from design and testing through production deployment.
* Experience rapidly scaling workforce, operational processes, and technology capacity in support of business growth or program expansion.
* Strong knowledge of implementation governance, program integration, dependency management, and risk management methodologies.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams and coordinating multiple concurrent implementation workstreams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* SAFe Agilist (SA), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent Agile certification.
* Cloud platform certifications (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) preferred.
* Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform certifications in solutions such as Five9, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, or Cisco Webex Contact Center are advantageous.

### **Desired Skills**

* Program and implementation management
* Deployment planning and execution
* Operational readiness assessment
* Enterprise systems integration
* Contact center operations
* Risk and dependency management
* Workforce ramp planning
* Capacity management and forecasting
* Testing and transition management
* Cross-functional leadership
* Executive communications and reporting
* Change management and stakeholder engagement

### **Experience Highlights**

Successful candidates will have a proven track record of leading large-scale implementation efforts involving complex technology deployments, operational transitions, contact center modernization initiatives, CCaaS migrations, or enterprise service delivery programs. Experience managing implementation activities across technology, people, processes, facilities, and operations while meeting aggressive deployment schedules is highly desirable.

Position Contingency Notice  
  
This position is being recruited in support of an upcoming federal contract opportunity and is contingent upon contract award, funding, and final client approval. ITCON Services is proactively identifying qualified candidates in anticipation of the program's potential start. Candidates selected for consideration will be kept informed regarding the anticipated timeline and status of the opportunity throughout the recruitment process.

### **Overview**

The Global Seller Onboarding team works directly with sellers and internal teams to ensure they are able to take full advantage of Square's products and services. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists work closely with teams within Sales & Account Management as well as Product Specialists and Product Marketing Managers to deliver a seamless and exceptional merchant experience and give key input into the product roadmaps for customer-facing developer products. Additionally, Global Seller Onboarding Specialists play a key role in merchant discovery and lead the final stages of the sale, working with Square's upmarket sellers and cross-functional teams to successfully implement and activate new accounts.

Square initially pioneered the simple self-service model to enable small businesses to take a payment. Now, we aspire to expand that same seamless experience up-market. This position will play a pivotal role in establishing seller success needed for us to drive growth, retention, and scale our services up-market. We're working to find new and better ways to help businesses succeed on their own terms—and we're looking for people like you to help shape tomorrow at Square.

**Seller Onboarding Expert - L3 (IC)**

**You Will (Responsibilities):**

### **Strategic Onboarding & Education (Estimated 70% of work)**

* Guide sellers (customers) to start transacting with Square quickly and with confidence, delivering high-quality onboarding and implementation experiences for Square's SMB and mid-market sellers
* Lead seller-facing scoping and onboarding calls, help sellers along their onboarding journey by delivering tailored, necessary training content, and support sellers after they begin transacting with Square
* Learn and maintain a strong understanding of relevant product features and releases
* Execute onboarding best practices consistently while escalating complex product or technical needs.
* Balance the needs of numerous (20-30) sellers at any given time, ensuring successful completion of each onboarding engagement

### **Project / Process Execution (Estimated 20% of work)**

* Identify issues or blockers that could affect a seller's onboarding experience or go-live date, and escalate appropriately to senior team members or cross-functional partners.
* Contribute to improvements in onboarding processes by documenting gaps, proposing refinements, and sharing observations from seller engagements.
* Maintain clear, proactive communication with assigned sellers and demonstrate the ability to maintain an onboarding tracker with key milestones, target dates, and next steps to keep sellers informed and on track for go-live.
* Help sellers understand and complete the steps required for launch, following up on outstanding needs and confirming readiness ahead of their target go-live date.
* Use AI to improve the seller experience and automate or enhance internal processes.

### **Team Collaboration & Skill Development (Estimated 10% of work)**

* Take ownership of keeping product knowledge current, including new features, updates, and known limitations, to provide sellers with accurate guidance.

* Participate in internal meetings, training, roadmap updates, and optimization discussions to build broader product and organizational understanding.
* Escalate product, process, or policy issues clearly and promptly to senior teammates and product teams; assist in resolving routine internal or client concerns.
* Demonstrate reliability and consistency in onboarding execution while learning to manage more complex workflows.
* Comfortable working in a high-volume, high-tempo, customer-focused onboarding environment.

* Experience managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously with reliable delivery.

* Proactive attitude and eagerness to learn; ability to apply feedback quickly.
* Strong time-management and organizational skills.
* Comfort operating through change and ambiguity with appropriate support.

jobs.description:
What You'll Do:

The **Sr Associate, Client Service Onboarding Manager** will lead an assigned group of clients at a plan level, through the retirement plan onboarding process by coordinating all aspects of the projects plan, providing updates to stakeholders while maintaining overall responsibility for a best-in-class onboarding experience. Build trust and satisfaction from day one by delivering reliable support and fostering strong client relationships.

  

* Client facing Support & Communication: Manage onboarding for an assigned portfolio or block of business, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the process. Guide and consult plan sponsors, adviors, TPA's, participants, internal teams and/or distribution partners through onboarding and client strategy by providing expert support, timely communication, and clear direction. Communicate effectively with all stakeholders by providing timely status reports through scheduled update calls and timeline/project plan updates. Ensure onboarding activities are completed accurately and in alignment with company policies and service standards. Demonstrate flexibility to meet client needs. Collaborate with senior COMs and internal partners to resolve issues, set expectations, and deliver a smooth onboarding experience.
* Transactional & Technical Processing: Ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution in alignment with internal procedures and regulatory requirements. Maintain and reconcile client and participant records and resolve discrepancies with minimal oversight. Lead internal contract and plan/policy-level coding to support onboarding setup and serve as a resource for troubleshooting and process improvement. Oversee onboarding activities, including contributions, distributions, rollovers, loans, investment elections, beneficiary updates.
* Compliance & Risk Management: Accurately process onboarding transactions in alignment with regulatory and procedural guidelines (e.g., ERISA, IRS rules, state insurance regulations). Identify potential risks proactively and recommend solutions. Support internal audits by maintaining thorough records and documentation.
* Operational Excellence & Collaboration: Independently manage onboarding processes with attention to detail and timeliness. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve routine issues and ensure smooth handoffs. Identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements within own workflow.
* Perform other job-related duties and special projects as required.

Who You Are:

* 2+ years of experience in onboarding retirement plans (i.e. 401(k), 403(b), client service, financial services, or plan/policy operations or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, and negotiation skills.
* Excellent relationship building and communication skills, including verbal, written, video and presentation skills.
* Strong knowledge of defined contribution plans, including plan design, products, services, administrative systems, investments, laws and regulations is preferred.
* Proficient analytical, innovative, and creative thinking, along with problem solving skills.
* Proven ability to take initiative and have organizational skills to work efficiently to meet deadlines on multiple transitions.
* Highly focused on accuracy, details, and confidentiality.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and experienced with recordkeeping or workflow systems.
* Able to manage multiple tasks and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

**Section 2: Position Purpose**
===============================

The Onboarding Specialist manages an assigned onboarding desk and coordinates the timely completion, verification, and documentation of pre-hire requirements for assigned affiliates. Reporting to the Supervisor, Pre-Hire Compliance & Onboarding, the Specialist verifies required state, federal, county, medical, and program-specific clearances against approved requirements and communicates documented readiness within delegated authority. The role owns case follow-up, desk self-audits, accurate trackers and dashboards, required system fields, and weekly reporting on assigned metrics. The Specialist keeps the Supervisor informed of delays, roadblocks, at-risk start dates, affiliate feedback, and recommended improvements. The position does not independently waive requirements, interpret unresolved regulatory questions, make clinical determinations, or issue eligibility or adverse-action decisions reserved to authorized reviewers. Recruitment retains sourcing and recruiting responsibilities.

**Section 3: Major Responsibilities**
=====================================

* **Assigned desk and case ownership:** Manage assigned candidates and onboarding cases from handoff through documented clearance and transition to the designated next owner. Review priorities, target start dates, outstanding items, and aging cases daily; maintain clear ownership, next actions, and follow-up dates.
* **State, federal, and county clearances:** Initiate, track, obtain, and verify applicable background checks, screenings, and clearances using approved state-, federal-, county-, affiliate-, and position-specific checklists. Confirm that records correspond to the correct individual, satisfy documented requirements, and remain valid for the intended start date; route discrepancies and potentially disqualifying results to authorized reviewers.
* **Medical clearance coordination:** Coordinate required appointments, submissions, and follow-up with candidates and approved providers. Verify receipt of required medical clearance documentation or authorized clearance status without making clinical judgments. Restrict access to medical information and communicate only the minimum necessary status through approved channels.
* **Program and regulatory requirements:** Apply approved requirement matrices for assigned programs, service lines, locations, and roles, including required credentials, licenses, certifications, training, and other documented prerequisites. Seek Supervisor or Compliance clarification when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or not addressed in approved guidance.
* **Readiness verification and clearance controls:** Confirm that all applicable requirements, verification evidence, and required approvals are complete before marking a case cleared or communicating readiness within delegated authority. Maintain holds for unresolved requirements; never bypass controls, waive requirements, or promise a start date before required approvals are obtained.
* **Candidate follow-up and service:** Explain required steps, submission instructions, deadlines, and next actions clearly. Follow up on outstanding items according to approved service expectations, document outreach and responses, and identify assistance needed to prevent avoidable delays.
* **Desk self-audits and file quality:** Audit the assigned desk at least weekly using approved checklists, with additional reviews before clearance and as directed. Compare case files with trackers, dashboards, and source systems; identify missing, expired, inconsistent, or incorrectly filed records. Document deficiencies, corrective actions, due dates, and closure evidence, and escalate unresolved gaps.
* **Supervisor communication and escalation:** Notify the Supervisor promptly of delays, roadblocks, missing information, vendor or system issues, unresolved clearance questions, and at-risk start dates. Provide the case reference, outstanding requirement, aging, operational impact, actions already taken, responsible party, next follow-up date, and specific support or decision needed. Escalate urgent concerns when identified rather than waiting for the weekly report.
* **Affiliate and stakeholder communication:** Provide timely, accurate status updates to assigned affiliate contacts, Recruitment, hiring managers, and other authorized stakeholders. Explain pending requirements and handoffs without sharing restricted screening or medical details. Document commitments, changes, and unresolved concerns in approved systems.
* **Affiliate feedback and service improvement:** Capture affiliate feedback, recurring questions, handoff concerns, and service barriers. Share themes and specific examples with the Supervisor, recommend practical improvements, and communicate approved resolutions back to the appropriate stakeholders.
* **Tracker, dashboard, and system-field maintenance:** Update approved records as case activity occurs and complete a weekly reconciliation before the reporting deadline. Maintain required fields, including assigned affiliate, state, county or program where applicable, case owner, stage, milestone dates, pending requirements, hold reason, last outreach, next action, target start date, and clearance status. Correct stale or inconsistent entries and report system defects to the Supervisor.
* **Weekly metric reporting:** Prepare and submit reports on assigned desk metrics by the established weekly deadline using approved definitions and reporting periods. Include beginning and ending caseload, new assignments, completed or cleared cases, pending cases by stage, aging, turnaround time, overdue follow-ups, holds and delay reasons, start-date risks, audit findings, corrections, and other assigned measures. Distinguish external dependencies from internal processing delays and explain material changes.
* **Reporting accuracy and action follow-through:** Reconcile reported totals to source records, identify missing data, avoid duplicate counts, and document unresolved discrepancies. Include key roadblocks, affiliate feedback, improvement recommendations, action owners, and due dates in weekly updates. Carry open actions forward until closure is verified.
* **Audit support and document control:** Maintain complete, accurate, properly indexed, and retrievable records in approved repositories. Supply requested evidence for internal and external audits through designated channels, respond to assigned findings, and preserve a traceable record of verification and approvals.
* **Confidentiality and secure handling:** Protect candidate, employee, screening, and medical information through approved access, storage, transmission, and retention procedures. Use authorized systems and report suspected access or information-handling issues promptly through established channels.
* **Coverage and handoffs:** Maintain current desk notes and provide documented handoffs for absences, reassignment, and cleared cases. Identify urgent cases, pending deadlines, open escalations, and next actions so backup staff and receiving teams can continue work without duplicate processing or missed requirements.
* **Training and approved process changes:** Complete required training, remain current on approved procedures and requirement updates, participate in cross-training, and apply Supervisor-approved changes consistently. Recommend improvements that reduce rework and delays without weakening compliance controls.
* **Additional assignments and remediation:** Complete assigned projects, targeted file reviews, and other related onboarding duties. Track separately assigned legacy employee-file remediation independently from new-hire onboarding metrics and communicate competing priorities or capacity constraints to the Supervisor.

**Section 6: Job Qualifications and Competencies**
==================================================

**Job Qualifications**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in human resources, business administration, healthcare administration, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in onboarding, HR administration, credentialing, compliance support, or another documentation-intensive administrative role preferred.

jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**What You’ll Do****:**

As **Professional Services Manager** (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.

* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.

* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

* Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
* Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
* Formal project or change management certification.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist - Procurement Solutions
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. This is a role on the Implementation team, suited to someone who has already worked in hospital pharmacy purchasing or cost-savings optimization, and can bring that domain depth directly into how our customers configure and adopt Procurement solutions.

As a member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly attentive to detail, comfortable talking with pharmacy buyers, purchasing directors, and finance stakeholders, and can operate in an environment that is often ambiguous and requires creativity to resolve issues.

### **Representative Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage all aspects of Procurement Solution implementation projects, including project kick-off, software and pricing/contract configuration, go-live, and training, while maintaining project timelines.
* Configure and validate data, system outcomes, workflows, , and wholesaler/purchasing data feeds so customers' performance is tracked accurately from go-live.
* Act as the main point of contact for customers before they go live, owning all communications including weekly check-in meetings, ad hoc calls, and emails.
* Manage multiple implementation projects at once, across customers with different priorities, purchasing structures, and deadlines.
* Work as a consultative partner with customers' purchasing and pharmacy teams, advising on best practices for pharmacy cost-savings optimization, 340B compliance, and GPO/contract alignment.
* Train customer stakeholders on the CostCheck savings methodology and how to interpret savings-vs-cap performance so they're self-sufficient after go-live.
* Train customer stakeholders on the 340BCheck compliance and audit workflows within the system to provide them assistance in HRSA audits.
* Train customer stakeholders on ShortageCheck use and medication tracking.
* Act as a liaison between the customer, wholesalers/GPOs, and Bluesight's internal Clinical, Product, and Dev teams to facilitate technical and pricing configuration of the software.
* Maintain up-to-date project plans, tickets, and other project documentation so timelines stay on track and visible to leadership.
* Serve as a senior resource for the Implementation team on purchasing- and cost-related questions, helping onboard and support other Implementation Specialists.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to support rollout, meet with key stakeholders, and represent Bluesight professionally in front of customers.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, pharmacy, healthcare management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience, with a background aligned to hospital pharmacy purchasing, buying, procurement, or pharmacy cost-savings optimization (e.g., experience as a buyer or in a similar purchasing-facing role).
* 2+ years of project management and/or client-facing experience, ideally implementation-related.
* Strong familiarity with pharmacy cost savings programs, 340B program requirements, and group purchasing organizations (GPOs) preferred.
* Experience in the healthcare industry, ideally hospital pharmacy or health-system purchasing.
* Strong financial and data analysis skills, with the ability to assess savings performance and identify optimization opportunities during implementation.
* Ability to adapt to change, think quickly, and work independently.
* Team-player attitude and a willingness to get things done, including mentoring less-senior teammates.
* High attention to detail.
* Ability to build trusting, communicative, and results-oriented relationships with customers, including purchasing and finance stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* ***Willingness and ability to travel within the US as needed.***

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) credentials a strong plus.
* ACE certification a strong plus.
* Excel and SQL skills a plus.
* Previous experience with EMRs/ADCs (e.g., EPIC and Cerner) or purchasing/wholesaler platforms a plus.

The standard base pay range for this role is $75,000 - $85,000 when annualized. In addition to base salary this position is also eligible for an amazing benefits package. Actual amount of salary will vary depending on position offered, experience, performance, and location.

**This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.**

Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters.
